all_found.desc: [BUG] The --base last-reviewed no-fork-point error says 'no local main or master it branched from', but since 358237a ForkPoint also reports no fork point when main exists and HEAD is reachable from it (detached main tip, branch fast-forwarded into main, branch with no commits of its own). The message then names a cause that is false. Tracked as beads mr-dvf. A user on a detached main tip or an empty feature branch is told main/master is missing, looks for a nonexistent branch problem, and cannot tell the real fix (commit work on a branch off main, or pass an explicit --base).
